messages:
hana: Quick note — I enabled `shard_prefix_cache` (scope=segment) in staging and saw a tiny slice of preview traffic route to the spot pool. Unexpected.

kevin: saw the blip on the routing heatmap. can you paste the flag JSON?

hana: paste:
```json
{
  \"name\": \"shard_prefix_cache\",
  \"scope\": \"segment\",
  \"cache\": \"prefix\",
  \"rollout\": {\"pct\": 12}
}
```

jo: likely the evaluator ordering: cache transform runs before route-tier checks when scope!=tenant. we have an old quirk for prefix caches. opened issue OPS-1139.

infra-bot: [09:12] Autoscaler: no activity on latency pools.

hana: problem is telemetry — rollout events only include final route and flag id. can't repro decision path. we need a tiny eval trace and a hashed_segment id for privacy.

kevin: proposal: add compact enum trace to proto (C1=segment-resolve, C2=cache-prefix, C3=route-eval). Add flag field `telemetry_level` with values basic|trace|off. Default basic.

jo: console needs a dryrun API to preview ordering impact. POST /v1/config/dryrun {tenant_hash, route_key, seq, flag_ids} -> {decision, trace:["C2","C1","C3"], estimated_route_delta}.

hana: privacy note: dryrun telemetry must only log sample_hash + flag id. no raw tenant ids.

kevin: safety gate: if dryrun predicts >0.1% of rollout hitting non-latency pool for flags with `latency_sensitive=true`, block the live bump and require an approver override. Console shows blocking reason and required approver.

jo: plan: 1) proto enum + telemetry_level (kevin). 2) dryrun service/routing-sim (jo). 3) console preview wiring + blocking UI (hana). 4) short-term: revert flag in staging.

infra-bot: [09:28] Flag revert: `shard_prefix_cache` rollout.pct=0 by hana.

console-bot: [09:29] Dryrun job queued (id dq-900).

kevin: one debate left: enums vs human strings on wire. enums win for size; console maps codes to text.

hana: agree. also add a short `config-eval/ordering.md` doc explaining evaluation order and cache vs routing examples. logging this into the retro. :thumbsup:
